narrationTexts: I'll look at the codebase to size this up.
finalText:
**Big but shallow. 1082 hits across 94 files.**

| Zone | Hits | Why it must not move |
|---|---|---|
| repo SQL strings | 125 | column is still `account_id` |
| [migrations/](migrations) 12 files | 61 | already applied in production |
| repo JSONB payload key | 25 | shape of stored rows |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk) | 20 | overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh` |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | 5 | public contract, frozen field |
| [lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8) | 3 | audit log field name |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) wire value | 1 | public JSON key |

About 241 are frozen. The other ~841 are JS params and locals. Those rename freely. Rename only the left key in `WIRE`.

Next: make the ticket name these seven zones as out of scope.
